correctness.rationale: For the trace-zero box section Q with -A<=d_i<=B and coprime B<=A<=nB, the only facet orbits are coordinate c=-A when A<nB and c=B always. Fixing c, shift remaining n coordinates by A to z_j in [0,L], sum S=nA-c=kL+h. Cube-section vertices have k upper coordinates and, if h>0, one fractional-position coordinate, giving r=binom(n,k) when h=0 or n binom(n-1,k) otherwise. The primitive rays correspond to these vertices because their coordinates include a -A and B and gcd(A,B)=1. Differences span D times the trace-zero root lattice R, with D=L, h, L-h or gcd(L,h) in the four specified cases. The ray lattice is Z*v+DR; in the unimodular basis (e_i-e_n,e_n), Smith determinantal divisors yield (1,D^(n-2),D*abs(c)). Standard toric exact sequence gives free rank r-n and these torsion factors. Independently enumerated primitive facet rays and integer Smith forms for 124 chart cases across 2<=n<=5, B<=4, all coprime allowed A, reproducing the formula and omitted degenerate facet. Symbolic lattice argument establishes all n,A,B.
